title: Bounded WFS Simple stored-query discovery and GetFeatureById

source.description: Local shared-auth WFS 2.0 KVP capability, route, authoritative feature-read, fail-closed parameter, and explicit non-conformance evidence for the mandatory immutable GetFeatureById stored query.

expectedOutcomes.assertion: OpenGeo independently supplies bounded WFS 2.0 ListStoredQueries, DescribeStoredQueries, and GetFeatureById outcomes through its authoritative feature store without a GeoServer runtime dependency or conformance claim.
The authenticated WFS compatibility lane exposes mandatory immutable stored-query discovery and exact feature-id reads while rejecting ambiguous selectors.
The service-side WFS Simple stored-query prerequisite is locally implemented and tested; direct OpenLayers WFS evidence and official service conformance remain separate gates.
